missing_object.title: What went missing?
missing_object.summary: Explore a room, remember its contents, and identify an object after it disappears.
objectives: Explore and remember the initial scene
Inspect the scene after the hidden change
Report the missing object and its previous location

moved_object.title: Where did it move?
moved_object.summary: Find a displaced object and connect its previous and current locations.
objectives: Remember objects and their locations
Search the changed scene
Identify the moved object and both locations

shape_identification.title: A different point of view
shape_identification.summary: Move the camera to identify a three-dimensional shape across different projections.
objectives: Inspect the target shape
Choose informative camera viewpoints
Submit the matching candidate

pose_alignment.title: Reason about rotation
pose_alignment.summary: Control the viewpoint and the object independently to align a target pose.
objectives: Compare target and reference poses
Rotate the object around its own axes
Submit a symmetry-aware pose alignment

memory_maze.title: Remember the way back
memory_maze.summary: Explore real indoor landmarks, then revisit them in the requested order.
objectives: Explore and memorize indoor landmarks
Revisit and mark the ordered landmarks
Finish near the final landmark

dependency_doors.title: Plan before you pick
dependency_doors.summary: Open containers, retrieve and deliver objects, then restore the container state.
objectives: Open the source container before retrieval
Carry and place each requested object
Close used containers and finish with an empty hand

relational_rearrangement.title: Put relations into action
relational_rearrangement.summary: Place an object to satisfy spatial relations while preserving the rest of the scene.
objectives: Pick up the requested object
Place it to satisfy all specified spatial relations
Preserve protected objects and finish empty-handed

dynamic_replanning.title: When the route changes
dynamic_replanning.summary: Discover a real obstruction after a checkpoint and find another route.
objectives: Reach the checkpoint and trigger the change
Observe the obstruction and find a detour
Reach, mark, and finish near the destination

signal_repair.title: Inspect, diagnose, repair
signal_repair.summary: Inspect equipment, apply the appropriate repair, and preserve healthy stations.
objectives: Inspect the stations
Repair faults and preserve healthy equipment
Activate and verify the final system state

resource_delivery.title: Deliver within constraints
resource_delivery.summary: Plan pickup, delivery, and replenishment under time and energy constraints.
objectives: Plan pickups and available resources
Complete ordered deliveries
Respect time and energy constraints
